name: Detailed Transaction Statistics 26
definition: Information about outstanding derivatives, outstanding derivatives with no margin and outstanding derivatives with outdated margin.

NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithNoMarg.name: Number Of Outstanding Derivatives With No Margin Information
NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithNoMarg.definition: Number of outstanding derivatives with no margin information.

NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithOutdat.name: Number Of Outstanding Derivatives With Outdated Margin Information
NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithOutdat.definition: Number of outstanding derivatives with outdated margin information.

Warnings.name: Warnings
Warnings.definition: Details of the outstanding derivatives for which no margin information has been reported, or the margin information that was reported is dated more than fourteen calendar days earlier than the day.
